title: PiximiProtocol
description: Generated by piximi-schema; do not edit.

AnnotationHeader.description: An annotation without its mask; masks are fetched separately.
AnnotationHeader.title: AnnotationHeader

AnnotationsDidUpdate.description:
Objects were categorized or had partitions or predictions written:
the category and prediction live on the volume, the partition on each
annotation.
AnnotationsDidUpdate.title: AnnotationsDidUpdate

BackendErrorData.description:
Carried in an RPC error's ``data`` when a backend operation fails;
becomes a ``BackendError`` on the frontend.
BackendErrorData.title: BackendErrorData

Capability.description: What a backend declares it can do; the frontend hides the rest.
Capability.title: Capability

CategoriesDidChange.description:
A category was created, renamed, recoloured or deleted. Carries the
whole list, which is short, so a client replaces what it holds.
CategoriesDidChange.title: CategoriesDidChange

Channel.description:
A channel's metadata. Where its pixels live is the backend's business,
so the frontend's ``storageReference`` has no wire counterpart.
Channel.title: Channel

ChannelDisplay.description:
Per-client display settings; they travel with every request and are
never stored by the backend.
ChannelDisplay.title: ChannelDisplay

ChannelIndexOptionField.description:
A 1-based index into the channels sent to the model; ``0`` means
``zero_label``.
ChannelIndexOptionField.title: ChannelIndexOptionField

ChannelPolicyFixed.description:
The model needs exactly ``count`` planes; the user maps one image channel
onto each.
ChannelPolicyFixed.title: ChannelPolicyFixed

ChannelPolicyPassthrough.description: The model is channel-agnostic and takes up to ``max_channels`` as-is.
ChannelPolicyPassthrough.title: ChannelPolicyPassthrough

ClassifierUpdateRequest.description: Changes to a classifier's settings between runs; absent fields stay.
ClassifierUpdateRequest.title: ClassifierUpdateRequest

ClassifiersDidChange.description:
A classifier was created, updated, trained, deleted or imported, or a
job began or finished with it. Carries every classifier of the project.
ClassifiersDidChange.title: ClassifiersDidChange

ClassifiersDidEpoch.description: One epoch of a training run finished; appended to the run's history.
ClassifiersDidEpoch.title: ClassifiersDidEpoch

ConfidenceRange.description:
Keeps items whose prediction confidence lies strictly between ``min``
and ``max``; items without one are left out.
ConfidenceRange.title: ConfidenceRange

ImageQuery.description:
Every condition given must hold; an absent one does not restrict.
Ties in any sort fall back to insertion order.
ImageQuery.title: ImageQuery

ImagesDidRemove.description:
Images are gone, with everything under them; the ids are enough for
a client to drop what it mirrors.
ImagesDidRemove.title: ImagesDidRemove

ImagesDidUpdate.description:
Images were categorized, or had partitions or predictions written;
each update carries the fields a category change rewrites.
ImagesDidUpdate.title: ImagesDidUpdate

Job.description: Long-running work on the backend, visible to every client of a session.
Job.title: Job

ModelDescriptor.description:
Any model a backend lists: a segmenter, or an architecture a classifier
can be built from. ``tasks`` says which; ``output_policy`` is present for
models that segment.
ModelDescriptor.title: ModelDescriptor

ModelStatus.description:
Where a model is on the way to being usable. A model that runs in its
own environment starts ``unavailable`` until that environment is built.
ModelStatus.title: ModelStatus

ModelTask.description: What a model can do, named like the capabilities that expose it.
ModelTask.title: ModelTask

ModelsDidChange.description:
The model list changed: one was registered, or its status moved (an
environment built, weights loaded, a failure). Carries the whole list,
which is short, so a client replaces what it shows.
ModelsDidChange.title: ModelsDidChange

OutputPolicyClasses.description: One kind per output class, chosen per detection by the model.
OutputPolicyClasses.title: OutputPolicyClasses

OutputPolicySingle.description: Every annotation lands in one kind, named by the user.
OutputPolicySingle.title: OutputPolicySingle

ProgressParams.description: ``$/progress``: the caller supplied ``token`` in the request's params.
ProgressParams.title: ProgressParams

ThumbnailsPartial.description: Progress payload of ``render/thumbnails``: results as they complete.
ThumbnailsPartial.title: ThumbnailsPartial
